decisions.reason: It builds directly on the firm's authentication, secure communication, and cryptography knowledge, so with strong in-house R&D in a growing market the firm is well placed to learn from early adoption and refine it.

A mobile PDF digital signature function is very close to the firm's secure identity and transaction-authorization capabilities, making it a natural extension that the firm can improve and commercialize effectively.

A multi-layer end-to-end security architecture closely matches the firm's core technical base and benefits from its absorptive capacity in integrating complex security components for regulated customers.

Secure email-to-app message delivery builds on the firm's established second-channel communication and app-security expertise, so management would expect to interpret customer feedback well and enhance the offering.

Although somewhat more specialized, the QR-code-based hardware signature token remains close to the firm's signing, hardware-option, and strong-authentication know-how, which supports continued development rather than early withdrawal.

The payment network security compliance suite extends the firm's existing security and compliance capabilities into another regulated use case, and its R&D base should help absorb domain-specific knowledge and improve market fit.
